d:
The Nuggets defeated the Suns, 127-120 tonight in Phoenix. Jamal Murray finished with a team-high 39 points along with 8 rebounds and 7 three pointers for the Nuggets, while Christian Braun tallied 31 points, 7 three pointers and 3 rebounds in the game. Miles Bridges recorded 24 points, 10 rebounds and 2 assists. The Nuggets improve their record to 3-2 with the win, while the Suns fall to 1-3 for the season.
